title: Virtual call segments
statement: Given a call specification, a Boolean input word $x$, and a word $W_i$ for each of its $m$ registers, the call’s segment list consists of the initial segment selected by the call mode and $x$, followed by the segments formed from the words of the registers listed in the call specification, in their listed order.
hypotheses_covered: A call specification with register count $m$ and decider count $d$
A word-valued assignment to each of the $m$ registers
caveat: The snippet refers to the constructions of the initial segment and argument segments, but does not include their definitions.
